answer: Re-attestations are stored in gale and timber lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the oasis graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 842 impostors cost 955 times the honest price and take 5 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
